scope: Project Rules Agent extraction, organization, independent review and publication. These are processing instructions, never scientific project R rules.

responsibility_boundary.compression: Identify and preserve PROJECT_FACT and PROJECT_ASSUMPTION in the reviewed context with their information status and source evidence. Preserve original requirement wording without publishing formal project rules.
responsibility_boundary.project_rules_agent: Reuse relevant reviewed context and re-read original sources to extract, classify, review and publish project requirements. Do not build a second project-fact or project-assumption extraction catalogue.
responsibility_boundary.missing_or_inconsistent_upstream_context: Return a source-linked correction request to compression; do not silently rewrite main.json or discard the discrepancy.
responsibility_boundary.implementation_status: Implemented for fresh contract 1.2 inputs; no historical migration or downstream compliance execution.

current_runtime.processing_rules: Seven focused PRC rules loaded from resources/project_rules/extraction_policy.1.2.json
current_runtime.legacy: 1.0/1.1 use their original inline rules and response contract.

inherits.delivery: Supply the applicable full shared text to fresh requests; do not rely on IDs alone.

settled_decisions.decision: Compression preserves original meaning; Project Rules Agent alone extracts and publishes formal project rules.
Formal rules have a separate artifact and consumption-stage/timing annotations.
Explicit authorized replacement relations permit updates while preserving prior versions; newer dates alone do not override.
Define a downstream applicability/compliance check contract now; connect its execution later.
Organized rules must be re-checked and re-validated; a prior draft review cannot approve changed final content.
PROJECT_FACT and PROJECT_ASSUMPTION identification belongs to compression. Project Rules Agent reuses and checks that context while extracting requirements; upstream omissions return to compression.

scientific_preservation_profile.delivery: Supply the complete listed scientific definitions once to each extraction/review call. Apply only relevant definitions, without importing compression-only access/workflow instructions.

qualification.method: Human-labeled withheld examples and real-model blind evaluation, including known critical semantic errors and valid negative cases.
qualification.metrics: The acceptance set must have no unblocked critical semantic errors. This is a finite-set criterion, not a claim of zero real-world errors. Further non-critical metrics remain to be agreed.

purpose: Extract a concise, complete collection of the explicit project requirements that downstream work must follow. PRC instructions govern this extraction; they are not themselves project R rules.
key_requirement_policy: Keep all adopted requirements whose omission could change permitted data use, analysis, interpretation, release decisions or required deliverables. Do not select only top-ranked rules or invent requirements to improve the project.
not_this_module: Re-extracting the full project fact or assumption catalogue
Creating scientific acceptance thresholds or required models from general PK knowledge
Running data QC, EDA, fitting, human prediction or downstream rule-compliance checks

rules.title: Identify effective project requirements
rules.instruction: Extract candidate requirements from the effective project specification, including requirements intended for later stages.
checks: Recheck the original proposal and designated protocols, supplements, clarifications and review decisions; use compression as supporting context.
Use existing project designations and decisions to establish adoption, effective version and replacement scope. Do not request the same confirmation again.
Keep draft, suggested, withdrawn or superseded requirements outside the active collection. Refer unresolved adoption or replacement questions to PRC008.

human_review.scope: The exact PRC001 title, instruction, three checks and general_rules shown in the preceding review. Other reorganized rules and methodology additions remain pending; runtime activation is unchanged.
human_review.change_policy: Re-review if approved meaning, scope or conditions change.

rule.title: Use the effective project requirements
rule.instruction: Identify which original project statements are adopted and currently applicable before extracting formal rules.
checks: Re-read the selected proposal and designated protocols, supplements, clarifications and review decisions; compression supplies context, not an authoritative rule list.
For each candidate, identify project adoption evidence and status. A source document's role or read permission alone does not establish adoption.
Apply documented amendments to their stated scope and conditions; retain predecessor references and flag unresolved replacement authority.

human_review.basis: User authorized focused restructuring. Prior approvals remain bound to the archived wording; this reorganization is not a blanket approval of all pending details.

rules.title: Extract decision-relevant project obligations
rules.instruction: Extract the source-supported requirements that govern how this project must be carried out, including constraints that limit the intended result.
checks: Look for required actions, prohibitions, permitted-use boundaries, fixed analysis choices and required decision gates concerning data, methods, interpretation or deliverables.
Retain every explicit consequential obligation, including conditional and later-stage requirements. Key means decision-relevant, not a fixed number of top-ranked rules.

Keep pure objectives, descriptive facts, assumptions and optional suggestions outside the formal rule collection. If the source requires an assumption to be used, extract that obligation and link the compression-owned assumption.

Interpret normative intent in context, not by keywords alone; do not create requirements from customary PK practice, literature choices or inferred scientific needs. An empty rule collection is valid when the source review supports it.

Apply explicit annotation definitions and positive/negative boundary examples. First decide whether a source statement is an adopted requirement, recommendation, non-rule or unresolved requirement; then fill its fields. Cue words direct attention but do not decide the classification.

human_review.basis: User authorized focused restructuring. Prior approvals remain bound to the archived wording; this reorganization is not a blanket approval of all pending details.
human_review.implementation_authorization: User adopted M01-M03 and requested corresponding rules and agent-code changes; this is not blanket wording approval.

rules.title: Extract a complete actionable requirement
rules.instruction: Represent each obligation together with the source-stated actor or target, required or prohibited action, applicability, conditions and exceptions.
checks: Extract linked qualifications across paragraphs, tables, footnotes and cross-references as one connected requirement; keep AND/OR, only-if and obligation strength intact.
For requirements containing scientific definitions, use the complete applicable preservation profile and PK binding appendix referenced by this contract.
Do not turn an unknown detail into a required value. If an upstream fact or assumption is missing or inconsistent, return a source-linked correction request to compression.

Fill only source-supported actor, action, target, normative form, source modality, workflow phase, deadline and frequency. Preserve multiple forms and linked alternatives; NOT_SPECIFIED is not permission to invent a value. Keep conditions, exceptions and observation windows in their existing dedicated fields.

human_review.basis: User authorized focused restructuring. Prior approvals remain bound to the archived wording; this reorganization is not a blanket approval of all pending details.
human_review.implementation_authorization: User adopted M01-M03 and requested corresponding rules and agent-code changes; this is not blanket wording approval.

rules.title: Bind each requirement to original evidence
rules.instruction: For every candidate rule, identify the original evidence that supports its full meaning and the project evidence that adopts it.
checks: Map each consequential clause to exact source spans, locations and relevant context; one source may support both meaning and adoption.
Record non-rule dispositions and their reasons in source coverage, using upstream fact and assumption references instead of recreating those catalogues.
Keep source-to-candidate links through organization so the final reviewer can inspect all contributing and contradictory evidence.

Bind each populated requirement field to exact admitted source spans. Include definitions and cross-paragraph qualifiers needed to interpret it. Cover every admitted source unit; relevant-context selection must not hide unselected obligations. A matching quotation proves location, not semantic support or project adoption.

human_review.implementation_authorization: User adopted M01-M03 and requested corresponding rules and agent-code changes; this is not blanket wording approval.

rules.title: Annotate when and where the rule is used
rules.instruction: Give each extracted rule source-grounded applicability and usage timing so downstream tasks receive the requirements they need.
checks: Preserve stated analysis, dataset, biological, endpoint and exposure restrictions; assign consumer stages using the workflow catalogue and distinguish that routing from source-stated applicability.
Keep observation windows separate from required workflow phases, triggers and deadlines. Do not bring a deferred requirement forward.
Use an explicit unresolved routing or applicability status when information is insufficient; do not invent task or dataset IDs. Usage annotations do not establish compliance.

rules.title: Clarify only gaps affecting requirement extraction
rules.instruction: Identify unresolved authority, obligation meaning, contradictions or applicability that prevent a faithful rule package.
checks: Return a targeted question linked to the affected candidate and source, stating what decision depends on the answer.
Block publication when requirement meaning, adoption, conflict or essential applicability remains unresolved; assess the impact before downgrading any issue.
Keep later-stage scientific data gaps with needed_at and impact. They are not new obligations or automatic blockers for this extraction step.

rules.title: Check the final extracted rule collection
rules.instruction: Independently review the organized candidate collection against the original project materials and reviewed context before publication.
checks: Record faithfulness, completeness and global-conflict outcomes for the final rule wording; the checks may share one fresh reviewer invocation.

Verify bidirectional source-unit-to-candidate-to-final-rule coverage. Each explicit consequential obligation must be represented; each final rule must have support. NO_REQUIREMENT must not conceal a mapped obligation.
Check that organization retained all rule qualifiers and sources and that the collection is consistent with the relevant main.json objective, facts, assumptions and data-use constraints.
Return required context changes to compression. Publish only the unchanged reviewed collection after the host checks its mappings and output contract.
Assess requirement detection, slot binding and grounding separately. Review the host-organized final rule records and their source/candidate mappings; bind the decision to their content hash.

inputs: Reviewed main.json and referenced scientific context
Original selected proposal and designated project materials
Source-adoption and replacement decisions supplied through authorized project inputs
Workflow stage catalogue and allowed-source metadata
classification_outputs: Non-rule source dispositions and upstream context references
Unresolved requirement questions with source-linked impact
extraction_contract.source_coverage: Inspect the admitted source material for obligations, including linked tables and footnotes. Account for non-rule content without copying it into the rule collection.
extraction_contract.organization: Apply G005 and retain source/candidate/final mappings. The current host's exact-merge keys belong to its implementation contract; broader semantic consolidation must reach final review before publication.
extraction_contract.missingness: Do not infer a scientific requirement from a missing measurement. Keep obligation ambiguity separate from later-stage data availability.
extraction_contract.methodology_delivery: Supply the compact runtime annotation guide once to each fresh extractor/reviewer; store bibliographic digests outside prompts.

rule_record_contract.status: PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED_1.2; downstream check execution and full amendment lineage remain deferred

fields.text: Complete actionable requirement with its stated obligation strength.
fields.evidence_refs: Original source spans, locations and context in rule_audit.json.
fields.adoption_evidence_refs: Evidence that the project adopts the requirement; may share refs with meaning evidence.
fields.scope: Applicable analysis and data restrictions, plus biological/PK distinctions when relevant.
fields.usage: Consumer stages, applicability status, required phase, trigger and deadline; separate the scientific observation window.
fields.lineage: Previous clause or published rule and the authorized scope of any replacement.
fields.unresolved_refs: Relevant clarification findings when the candidate cannot yet be finalized.

rule_record_contract.identifiers: The host allocates publication IDs. Citation IDs are not downstream dataset IDs; keep task/dataset ID lists empty until allocation supplies valid IDs.
rule_record_contract.missing_value_encoding: Retain contract-defined scalar missingness and explicit applicability/routing status; empty lists alone do not mean universal scope.

publication_contract.project_rules_json: The separate, versioned published rule collection with usage and evidence references.
publication_contract.main_json: Retain the reviewed scientific context and project_rules_ref; reserved rules stays empty.
publication_contract.rule_audit_json: Source coverage, quotes, classifications, exclusions, organization mappings, amendments and final review outcomes.
publication_contract.report_json: Publication decision and actionable extraction/review findings.
publication_contract.host_controls: Shared version binding, artifact integrity and release controls apply. Publication is not scientific validation or proof of downstream compliance.

proposed_flow: Read effective original project materials and reuse reviewed scientific context
Extract complete decision-relevant requirements, evidence links and usage annotations
Organize the candidate collection and source mappings using shared governance
Independently check the final collection for faithfulness, completeness and conflicts
Validate and publish project_rules.json with audit records and its main.json reference
review_efficiency: Reuse the existing extractor and independent reviewer roles. Do not add a separate model call for each rule. Resolve deterministic input/contract defects first; review the organized collection once. Changes follow G006/G007. No project-wide selective-rerun implementation is added.

revision.reason: User requested completion of shared principles and refocused PRC instructions on extracting the key project requirements.
revision.id_policy: Keep surviving PRC IDs; retire merged IDs with mappings rather than silently reusing their meanings.
revision.general_update: Shared general rules remain inherited. Focused PRC text and adopted methodology are supplied to new 1.2 inputs; remaining wording approvals remain pending.

methodology_ref.scope: M01-M03 methods integrated in runtime policy 1.2; approved PRC001 wording remains unchanged.

methodology_revision.authorization: User requested literature/methodological support and its addition; separately approved PRC001 with the message 第一个没问题.
methodology_revision.acceptance_scope: M01-M03 adopted and implementation authorized. PRC001 exact wording approval preserved; other wording reviewed sequentially.

runtime_activation.scope: Fresh prepared inputs only; historical inputs retain their original contract.
runtime_activation.formal_qualification: NOT_ESTABLISHED; offline tests are contract checks.

runtime_implementation.grounding: Per-field exact spans plus bidirectional source/item mapping; adoption also needs authority evidence and independent semantic review.
runtime_implementation.final_review: Host assembles final records before the fresh review. Publication and review hashes bind the same records.

runtime_implementation.validation_boundary: Metadata, quote and schema checks do not establish meaning or scientific validity.
